name: Trophies
overview: The Scriptures record trophies as tangible reminders of victory and defeat, often associated with significant spiritual and military events. David's taking of Goliath's head to Jerusalem and his request for Goliath's sword highlight trophies as symbols of God's deliverance (1 Samuel 17:54; 21:9). Conversely, the Philistines' treatment of Saul's body and armor—displaying his head and placing his armor in the temple of idols—illustrates how trophies could be used to dishonor and signify defeat (1 Samuel 31:8-10). These accounts reveal that trophies in the biblical context serve both as memorials of God's power and warnings of judgment.
